proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin::emanates_from_caster
proposed_widenings.justification: The emanation is self-centered and moves with the caster for the full duration. Existing AreaOrigin variants (point_within_range, on_primary_target) cannot represent a self-following mobile area. This is mechanically distinct from a static point-within-range area: the area continuously repositions to track the caster.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You conjure nature spirits that flit around you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation::area_contact_save_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage fires on area-contact events (emanation enters creature's space, creature enters emanation, or creature ends turn in emanation), gated by a Wisdom saving throw — full damage on fail, half on success. Neither roll_modifier nor damage_on_hit captures this pattern. damage_on_hit requires a weapon/spell attack roll hit; this spell has no attack roll. The trigger is environmental area-contact, not a hit event.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. The creature takes 5d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation — optional_trigger + per_turn_limit modifiers
proposed_widenings.justification: The save trigger is optional ('you can force') and the target makes the save at most once per turn. No existing surface type carries optionality or a per-turn limit for ongoing area saves. These are distinct authoring properties that affect when and how often the gate fires, not just what it does.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw... A creature makes this save only once per turn.

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom — bonus_action_activated deny_opportunity_attack
proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary rider grants the caster the ability to spend a Bonus Action each turn to take Disengage (deny OA for that turn's movement). The v4 deny_opportunity_attack atom exists but models a passive or unconditional grant. Here the effect costs a Bonus Action to activate on each individual turn — a persistent repeatable-cost-to-activate pattern absent from all current EffectAtom variants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action for the spell's duration.

notes: All required v4 atoms exist (save_gate, damage, area/emanation, deny_opportunity_attack). The unit does not fit any existing family honestly. The closest is ongoing_effect but three surface gaps prevent honest encoding: (1) AreaOrigin lacks an emanates_from_caster/self-following variant; (2) OngoingOperation lacks a save_gate variant with area-contact trigger, optionality, and per-turn limit; (3) EffectAtom lacks a bonus-action-activated deny_opportunity_attack pattern for the Disengage rider.
